sections.h: Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy (SUDI) scheme (Blackbook)
sections.html:

flows.title: Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy (SUDI)
flows.note: * SUDI with negative investigations and infant found in prone position or in bed with parent may be called either SIDS or injury (new ideas evolving)

nodes.t: Must be Reported to Medical Examiner

nodes.d:
• Autopsy negative
  • 80% of SUDI
  • Risk Factors:
    • Prone Sleeping position
    • Tobacco exposure
    • Sharing a Sleeping Surface
    • Prematurity
